knowledge:
- key_parameters: useq=grid of candidate thresholds (u) to evaluate in fdiscgammagpd ;; shift=minimum value in the support of the distribution, which should be the minimum clone size and never less than 1 ;; grid=range of integers over which distributions are evaluated in get_distances, which must start at the minimum clone size across all samples and end at a very large value (e.g., 100,000) to sufficiently capture the tail ;; modelType=character string specifying the model type ("Spliced" or "Desponds") in get_distances ;; method=linkage method for hierarchical clustering in clusterPlot (e.g., "ward.D" or complete linkage) ;; gridStyle=bootstrapping grid style in get_bootstraps (e.g., "copy" to copy the original useq parameter)
- alternatives: The discrete gamma-GPD spliced threshold model (Koch et al., 2018) is preferred for capturing imperfect power law behavior in TCR repertoires, whereas the Type-I Pareto model (Desponds et al., 2016) is provided for comparison and reproducibility. For file parsing, parseFile or parseFolder (wrappers for tcR package) can be used to read standard TCR formats, but users can alternatively supply a raw vector of clone sizes.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing TCR sequencing data to model clone size distributions, compare multiple repertoire libraries, perform model-based hierarchical clustering, or estimate repertoire diversity.
- pitfalls: Setting the shift parameter to a value less than 1 ;; choosing an upper bound for the evaluation grid in get_distances that is too small (failing to examine the tail sufficiently) ;; simulating data with unrealistic parameters (e.g., light-tailed gamma with a high threshold and high phi) ;; using too few bootstrap resamples (at least 1,000 resamples are recommended in practice, though smaller numbers can be used for quick testing).

workflows.name: discrete_gamma_gpd_spliced_threshold_analysis
workflows.intent: Fit the discrete gamma-GPD spliced threshold model to TCR clone size data, perform comparative clustering, estimate diversity, and run bootstrapping.
input: sample_tcr_repertoire.txt (TCR sequencing file in MiTCR, MiGEC, VDJtools, ImmunoSEQ, MiXCR, or IMSEQ format, or a vector of clone sizes)
workflows.stages: 1. Parse TCR files using parseFile or parseFolder ;; 2. Fit the discrete gamma-GPD spliced threshold model using fdiscgammagpd ;; 3. Extract MLEs and negative log-likelihoods using get_mle and get_nllh ;; 4. Compute theoretical quantiles using qdiscgammagpd and simulate data using rdiscgammagpd ;; 5. Compute pairwise Jensen-Shannon distances using get_distances with modelType="Spliced" ;; 6. Perform hierarchical clustering and plot using clusterPlot ;; 7. Extract diversity estimators using get_diversity ;; 8. Run parametric bootstrapping using get_bootstraps
workflows.code:
library(powerTCR)
data("repertoires")
fits <- list()
for(i in seq_along(repertoires)){
    thresholds <- unique(round(quantile(repertoires[[i]], c(.75,.8,.85,.9))))
    fits[[i]] <- fdiscgammagpd(repertoires[[i]], useq = thresholds,
                               shift = min(repertoires[[i]]))
}
names(fits) <- names(repertoires)
get_mle(fits)
get_nllh(fits)
n1 <- length(repertoires[[1]])
n2 <- length(repertoires[[2]])
q1 <- seq(n1/(n1+1), 1/(n1+1), length.out = n1)
q2 <- seq(n2/(n2+1), 1/(n2+1), length.out = n2)
theor1 <- qdiscgammagpd(q1, fits[[1]])
theor2 <- qdiscgammagpd(q2, fits[[2]])
set.seed(123)
s1 <- rdiscgammagpd(1000, shape = 3, rate = .15, u = 25, sigma = 15,
                    xi = .5, shift = 1)
s2 <- rdiscgammagpd(1000, shape = 3.1, rate = .14, u = 26, sigma = 15,
                    xi = .6, shift = 1)
s3 <- rdiscgammagpd(1000, shape = 10, rate = .3, u = 45, sigma = 20,
                    xi = .7, shift = 1)
sim_fits <- list("s1" = fdiscgammagpd(s1, useq = 25),
                 "s2" = fdiscgammagpd(s2, useq = 26),
                 "s3" = fdiscgammagpd(s3, useq = 45))
grid <- min(c(s1,s2,s3)):10000
distances <- get_distances(sim_fits, grid, modelType="Spliced")
clusterPlot(distances, method = "ward.D")
library(vegan)
get_diversity(sim_fits)
boot <- get_bootstraps(fits, resamples = 5, cores = 1, gridStyle = "copy")
library(magrittr)
library(purrr)
mles <- get_mle(boot[[1]])
xi_CI <- map(mles, 'xi') %>% 
    unlist %>%
    quantile(c(.025,.5,.975))

workflows.name: pareto_model_analysis
workflows.intent: Fit the Type-I Pareto model to TCR clone size data and perform comparative analysis.
input: sample_tcr_repertoire.txt (TCR sequencing file in MiTCR, MiGEC, VDJtools, ImmunoSEQ, MiXCR, or IMSEQ format, or a vector of clone sizes)
workflows.stages: 1. Parse TCR files or load clone size vectors ;; 2. Fit the Type-I Pareto model using fdesponds ;; 3. Compute pairwise Jensen-Shannon distances using get_distances with modelType="Desponds" ;; 4. Perform hierarchical clustering and plot using clusterPlot
workflows.code:
library(powerTCR)
data("repertoires")
desponds_fits <- list()
for(i in seq_along(repertoires)){
    desponds_fits[[i]] <- fdesponds(repertoires[[i]])
}
names(desponds_fits) <- names(repertoires)
